correctness.rationale: Every positive-valuation four-good terminal EF1 allocation among three agents has cardinalities (2,1,1): otherwise an empty agent envies a double bundle after deletion. In the (2,1,1) pattern, terminal EF1 reduces exactly to each singleton-holder i satisfying v_i(own singleton)>=min(v_i(double pair)). Therefore only each agent’s weak rank ordering matters, regardless of cardinal magnitudes. Exhaustive four-ply perfect-information minimax, adversary revealing any value triple BEFORE choice of recipient, gives adversary forcing values (L=3 free, L=3 distinct-first-two, L=3 same-first-two, L=4 free) = (0,1,1,1). Independently compiled C++ cardinal terminal check reproduced all four values with direct OR-over-triple/AND-over-recipients recurrences. Adaptive quantifiers correct; 3-level existence, 4-level impossibility and necessity of context-dependent first-two occupancy follow. The statement is restricted to terminal fairness, four goods, three agents, positive additive utilities, known horizon, deterministic policies and no future frequency predictions.
